definitions.explanation: A mixture of different ingredients, varieties, or elements combined to create a balanced or desired result. Most commonly used in the context of coffee and tea, but also applies to whisky, spices, and other products.

examples.japanese: ブレンドコーヒーを{一|ひと}つください。
{数|すう}{種類|しゅるい}の{茶葉|ちゃば}をブレンドした{紅茶|こうちゃ}です。
examples.english: This is a tea made by blending several types of tea leaves.

examples.japanese: このウイスキーは{複数|ふくすう}の{原酒|げんしゅ}をブレンドして{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This whisky is made by blending multiple base spirits.

notes:
USAGE: ブレンド is a loanword from English "blend." It can be used as a noun (ブレンド) or as a suru-verb (ブレンドする).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブレンドコーヒー (blended coffee — the default "house coffee" at most Japanese cafes)
- オリジナルブレンド (original/house blend)
- ブレンドする (to blend, to mix)
- ブレンド{茶|ちゃ} (blended tea)

COFFEE CULTURE NOTE: At Japanese {喫茶店|きっさてん} (coffee shops), ブレンド is the standard house coffee made from a mix of beans. It is typically the most affordable and popular option on the menu. Ordering just "ブレンド" is understood to mean a cup of blended coffee.
